articles.title: BBC Inside Science - The zeptoverse - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: A glimpse into the world of the incredibly tiny
articles.body: What does it mean to look inside the very fabric of the universe? This week on Inside Science, Tom Whipple enters the zeptoverse with particle physicist Harry Cliff, exploring a world a billion trillionth of a metre across, where scientists hope to find answers to some of the biggest mysteries in physics. And in our new weekly series, we explore the changing relationship between artificial intelligence and the things we hold dear. This week, Stuart Manley, the co-owner of Barter Books in Alnwick describes why his bookshop has been receiving some rather unusual orders. Plus, Penny Sarchet from the New Scientist joins us with the latest science news. BBC Inside Science is produced in partnership with The Open University. Presenter: Tom Whipple Producers: Harrison Lewis, Katie Tomsett, Tabitha Taylor Buck Editor: Martin Smith Production Co-ordinators: Jana Bennett-Holesworth and Owain Llion

articles.title: Santiago Peña é de direita ou esquerda? | G1
articles.standfirst: Aliado de Trump, Peña foi pai aos 17, estudou economia em Assunção, fez pós nos EUA, trabalhou no FMI e no Banco Central do Paraguai e foi ministro da Fazenda.
articles.summary: Aliado de Trump, Peña foi pai aos 17, estudou economia em Assunção, fez pós nos EUA, trabalhou no FMI e no Banco Central do Paraguai e foi ministro da Fazenda.
articles.body:
Santiago Peña reconhece que a saúde continua sendo um dos principais desafios do país — Foto: EPA

O presidente do Paraguai , Santiago Peña, que renunciou ao cargo nesta quinta-feira (5), é do filiado ao Partido Colorado, de direita.

Peña, de 47 anos, foi eleito presidente em abril de 2023. Ele substituiu Mario Abdo Benítez na Presidência do Paraguai, que também pertence ao mesmo partido.

A crise que levou à sua renúncia começou após o banco digital Ueno fechar as portas e deixar milhares de clientes sem acesso ao próprio dinheiro. Peña foi acionista do grupo que controla a instituição, e a oposição acusa o Banco Central paraguaio de encobrir irregularidades.

Ainda nesta quinta (5), o Congresso do país havia tomado os primeiros passos para votar um impeachment contra Peña e seu vice.

Santiago Peña é economista com formação nos Estados Unidos e uma passagem pelo Fundo Monetário Internacional —ele foi trabalhar no FMI aos 30 anos.

Foi eleito presidente em 2023, quando derrotou Efraín Alegre. Na época, acreditava-se que a popularidade do partido do vencedor estaria em baixa por uma economia em desaceleração e acusações de corrupção.

Em 2023 foi a segunda vez que ele candidatou: em 2018, Peña perdeu as primárias do Partido Colorado para o antecessor, Mario Abdo Benítez.

Antes, foi ministro da Fazenda do Paraguai durante o governo de Horácio Cartes (2013 a 2018) e, durante seu tempo no ministério, filiou-se ao Partido Colorado, o mais tradicional do Paraguai.

Ele é graduado pela Universidad Católica Nuestra Señora de Asunción, do Paraguai, e conseguiu um trabalho no Banco Central do país. Depois disso, foi fazer uma pós na universidade de Columbia, nos EUA, e então arrumou um emprego no FMI. Ele trabalhou no departamento do FMI para a África.

Depois de voltar do trabalho no FMI, ele incialmente voltou Banco Central do Paraguai. Depois, entre 2015 e 2017, tornou-se ministro da Fazenda do país e, quando acabou o governo de Cartes, ele foi trabalhar no banco do antigo chefe.

Peña foi pai adolescente, ele teve um filho aos 17 anos, quando ainda estava na escola. Ele ainda é casado com Leticia Ocampo, com quem teve um outro filho.

articles.title: Mudanças climáticas na educação: projeto reúne educadores em PVH | G1
articles.standfirst: Painel promovido pela Fundação Rede Amazônica reuniu 110 profissionais da rede municipal de ensino e contou com a participação de Bruno Lery, coordenador de Gestão Ambiental da Globo.
articles.summary: O painel Consciência Limpa reuniu educadores de Porto Velho e Bruno Lery, da Globo, para debater mudanças climáticas na educação e o impacto da reciclagem nas escolas.
articles.body:
Como abordar as mudanças climáticas desde os primeiros anos da educação? Essa foi uma das questões discutidas durante o Painel Consciência Limpa – Educação que Transforma, realizado nesta quinta-feira (5), no Teatro Banzeiros, em Porto Velho . Promovido pela Fundação Rede Amazônica, o encontro reuniu 110 participantes, entre professores, pedagogos e profissionais da rede municipal de ensino, para compartilhar experiências e discutir o papel da educação ambiental na formação de crianças e jovens.

O painel contou com a participação de Bruno Lery, engenheiro civil e coordenador de Gestão Ambiental da Globo, que compartilhou experiências sobre sustentabilidade e apresentou possibilidades de trabalhar questões ambientais no cotidiano escolar. Entre os temas abordados estiveram as mudanças climáticas, o consumo consciente e a importância de desenvolver práticas sustentáveis desde a infância.

Durante o encontro, o especialista destacou que a educação ambiental precisa estar presente nas atividades do dia a dia e que diferentes ferramentas podem aproximar crianças e adolescentes das discussões sobre o clima.

“Estamos fazendo um painel sobre a importância da educação ambiental, com professores, educadores e pedagogos da rede municipal de ensino de Porto Velho. Vamos abordar como essas ferramentas nos ajudam a trabalhar a questão climática e as mudanças climáticas com nossos jovens e crianças desde pequenas nas escolas, porque é um assunto que não podemos negligenciar. Isso faz parte do nosso cotidiano e existem formas de conversar com as crianças sobre isso, por meio do esporte e de atividades como as realizadas no projeto Consciência Limpa nas escolas. É uma troca de experiências”, destacou Bruno Lery.

A programação também reuniu profissionais das unidades de ensino que participaram da etapa-piloto do projeto. Para Miriam Pereira, gestora de Gestão Escolar da Secretaria Municipal de Educação (Semed), o painel ampliou o diálogo sobre os temas trabalhados durante as atividades nas escolas.

“Hoje acontece o painel do Consciência Limpa, em que trouxemos a rede para conversar um pouco mais sobre a temática do projeto-piloto, desenvolvido em três unidades. Reunimos os funcionários para escutar um pouco mais sobre sustentabilidade, descarte correto e assuntos de fundamental importância para o nosso planeta”, afirmou.

A diretora da EMEIEF Areal da Floresta, Eliene Soqueira, também destacou os reflexos do projeto na formação dos estudantes e na conscientização das famílias. Segundo ela, as atividades realizadas na escola ajudam a construir hábitos que podem ser levados para as próximas gerações.

“O projeto Consciência Limpa foi muito importante para a escola porque plantou uma sementinha para as crianças, que vão colher os frutos no futuro, para os filhos e os filhos deles. E elas levam essa consciência para os pais”, ressaltou.

Para Denis Carvalho, especialista em Projetos da Fundação Rede Amazônica, o painel representa uma oportunidade de dar continuidade às ações desenvolvidas com os estudantes e ampliar o alcance da educação ambiental.

“O Consciência Limpa mostra que pequenas atitudes podem gerar mudanças importantes quando envolvem toda a comunidade. A participação das escolas, dos estudantes e das famílias fortalece esse trabalho. Com o painel, ampliamos essa troca de conhecimentos e reforçamos a importância de levar a sustentabilidade para além das atividades do projeto, incorporando esse aprendizado à rotina escolar”, destacou.

Consciência Limpa: educadores de Porto Velho discutem mudanças climáticas — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

Mobilização nas escolas arrecadou mais de 46 mil materiais recicláveis

O painel marcou o encerramento da programação do Consciência Limpa 2026 em Porto Velho. Uma das principais atividades foi a Gincana Consciência Limpa, realizada entre 28 de setembro e 9 de outubro, com a participação de 430 estudantes de três escolas municipais: EMEIEF Areal da Floresta, EMEIEF Rio Madeira e EMEF Estela de Araújo Compasso.

A mobilização resultou na arrecadação de 46.045 materiais recicláveis, sendo 35.155 garrafas PET e 10.890 latinhas de alumínio. Com o envolvimento das famílias e da comunidade escolar, a iniciativa incentivou a coleta seletiva e mostrou como atitudes cotidianas podem contribuir para a redução dos resíduos descartados inadequadamente.

A gincana também reconheceu os estudantes que mais contribuíram com a arrecadação. Os primeiros colocados receberam tablets, enquanto os segundos e terceiros lugares foram contemplados com fones de ouvido e bolsas, respectivamente.

Da coleta à reciclagem: o destino dos materiais

Após a arrecadação nas escolas, os materiais foram encaminhados à Cooperativa Cata Norte, onde passam por etapas de preparação para a reciclagem. O processo começa com a separação dos resíduos por tipo e, no caso das garrafas PET, também por cores. Em seguida, os materiais são prensados, pesados e armazenados até o encaminhamento à indústria.

Nessa etapa, os resíduos podem ser transformados em matéria-prima para a fabricação de novos produtos, conectando o trabalho dos estudantes à atuação dos catadores, das cooperativas e do setor industrial.

A experiência também permitiu mostrar que a reciclagem vai além da coleta: envolve uma cadeia de trabalho e reaproveitamento que contribui para a destinação adequada dos materiais e para práticas mais sustentáveis.

O Consciência Limpa é um projeto da Fundação Rede Amazônica voltado à educação ambiental, à sustentabilidade e à cidadania. A iniciativa incentiva o descarte correto de resíduos, a adoção de práticas sustentáveis e a responsabilidade coletiva na preservação do meio ambiente.

Em Porto Velho, a gincana contou com o apoio da Cidade de Porto Velho, da Rioterra e da Eucatur.

articles.title: Carro invade loja em Manaus após motorista dormir ao volante | G1
articles.standfirst: Motorista afirmou à polícia que dormiu ao volante. Funcionária da loja atingida machucou o ombro e recebeu atendimento do Samu. Momento do acidente foi registrado ao vivo durante transmissão online.
articles.summary: Um carro invadiu uma loja em Manaus nesta quinta-feira (5) após a condutora dormir ao volante, atingindo uma atendente que precisou de atendimento médico do Samu.
articles.body:
Um carro invadiu uma loja na tarde desta quinta-feira (5), na Avenida João Valério, bairro Vieralves, Zona Centro-sul de Manaus . Uma atendente do estabelecimento ficou ferida. O momento do acidente foi registrado ao vivo. Assista acima .

O acidente aconteceu por volta de 16h30, quando a condutora de um Jeep Renegade perdeu o controle do veículo e atingiu a loja de roupas Guta Store.

No momento do ocorrido, a proprietária da loja e uma funcionária realizavam uma transmissão ao vivo no interior do estabelecimento. Elas divulgavam ofertas especiais para a black friday quando foram surpreendidas pelo veículo.

Segundo informações repassadas aos policiais da 22ª Companhia Interativa Comunitária (Cicom), a motorista afirmou que dormiu ao volante .

O Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) foi acionado e prestou atendimento à funcionária da loja ainda no local. Ela sofreu escoriações no ombro. O Samu não informou se a funcionária foi levada ao hospital, nem o estado de saúde dela.

Ainda de acordo com a polícia, a Perícia Criminal também esteve na loja onde o fato ocorreu para apurar as circunstâncias do acidente.

articles.title: Vídeo de pessoas coletando comida em caminhão de lixo é de 2021 | G1
articles.standfirst: Gravação foi registrada em setembro de 2021, durante governo do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, e tem circulado fora de contexto nas redes sociais.
articles.summary: Gravação foi registrada em setembro de 2021, durante governo do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, e tem circulado fora de contexto nas redes sociais.
articles.body:
É #FAKE que cena de pessoas pegando comida em caminhão de lixo ocorreu durante governo Lula; vídeo foi gravado em 2021 — Foto: Reprodução

Circula nas redes sociais um vídeo que mostra um grupo de pessoas coletando alimentos de um caminhão de lixo. As legendas alegam que a gravação seria atual, registrada durante o governo do presidente Lula ( PT ). É #FAKE .

Publicado no X e no Facebook desde quarta-feira (4), o vídeo mostra moradores carregando sacolas e baldes procurando alimentos em um caminhão de lixo.

Caixas de texto sobrepostas ao conteúdo dizem: "Já estamos ou não vivendo o regime comunista? Fome: moradores procuram comida em caminhão de lixo em Fortaleza. Imagina essa cena se espalhando por todo país" .

Veja duas legendas que têm circulado: "Em Fortaleza, capital do Ceará, nordeste do Brasil, mulheres procuram comida no caminhão de lixo. @LulaOficial cadê a ajuda pra esse povo do qual você disse que tirou da pobreza?" e "🚨 GRAVE: Moradores procuram comida em caminhão de lixo em Fortaleza (CE)" .

Apesar de o vídeo ser real — e não uma produção de inteligência artificial (IA), por exemplo — o vídeo está fora de contexto. O registro foi originalmente gravado em 28 de setembro de 2021 , durante o governo do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro ( PL ) — leia mais abaixo.

Para descobrir se o vídeo já tinha circulado na internet antes desta terça-feira, o Fato ou Fake usou a ferramenta InVID e fragmentou o material em vários frames (imagens estáticas). Depois, selecionou uma dessas "fotos" e fez uma busca reversa no Google Lens. Assim, chegou ao registro original .

Essa pesquisa serve para verificar o conteúdo havia sido reproduzido anteriormente por fontes confiáveis – e em que contexto.

O resultado levou a uma reportagem do g1 , publicada em 18 de outubro de 2021, com este título: "Moradores coletam comida em caminhão de lixo em Fortaleza; vídeo".

A cena foi filmada na porta de um supermercado no Bairro Cocó, área nobre de Fortaleza, em 28 de setembro, e publicada nas redes sociais em 17 de outubro pelo motorista de aplicativo André Queiroz.

Um ano depois, o g1 entrevistou Jocasta Batista dos Santos, uma das mulheres que aparece na filmagem. Na época, ela relatou que ainda dependia dos alimentos encontrados no caminhão .

articles.title: Motociclista tem pescoço cortado por linha chilena, mas escapa vivo | G1
articles.standfirst: Natan Peixoto disse que precisou deitar a moto para conseguir tirar a linha do pescoço. Vídeo mostra ele recebendo a ajuda das pessoas após acidente, nesta quinta-feira (5), no bairro São Pedro.
articles.summary: Natan Peixoto disse que precisou deitar a moto para conseguir tirar a linha do pescoço. Vídeo mostra ele recebendo a ajuda das pessoas após acidente, nesta quinta-feira (5).
articles.body:
Um motociclista teve o pescoço cortado por uma linha chilena na manhã desta quinta-feira (5), em Teresópolis , na Região Serrana do Rio. O comerciante Natan Peixoto estava sozinho na motocicleta quando percebeu que o fio estava baixo e atravessava a via.

Ao notar o risco, ele conseguiu parar a motocicleta e retirar a linha do pescoço. Para se desvencilhar do material, precisou deitar o veículo na pista. Segundo ele, o material era uma linha chilena, de cor amarela, com cerol. O motociclista não sofreu consequências mais graves.

Imagens feitas por moradores (veja acima) mostram a mobilização das pessoas nas ruas para ajudá-lo. Ao g1 , ele contou que precisou agir rápido para escapar com vida.

“Na hora que eu vi, o fio estava vindo baixo. Ainda tive o reflexo de parar a moto e tirar. Acabei deitando a moto na estrada para conseguir me livrar e, com as mãos, tirar a linha do meu pescoço”, contou Natan.

Homem percebeu o fio atravessando a pista, parou a motocicleta e retirou o material do pescoço. — Foto: Redes sociais

Natan aproveitou para alertar sobre os perigos desse tipo de linha , especialmente para quem utiliza motocicletas no dia a dia, como motoboys e trabalhadores que dependem do veículo.

“Graças a Deus, não aconteceu nada pior comigo. Mas fica o alerta para que as pessoas tenham consciência de que esse tipo de linha não é brincadeira. Os motociclistas e motoboys também devem procurar instalar antenas de proteção nas motos. A gente espera que haja mais fiscalização para coibir a venda desse tipo de produto”, afirmou.

A utilização e a comercialização de linhas cortantes, como cerol e linha chilena, são proibidas no estado do Rio de Janeiro. A Lei Estadual nº 7.784/2017, atualizada pela Lei nº 8.478/2019, proíbe o uso, o porte, a posse e a comercialização desses materiais.

A legislação prevê penalidades para quem descumprir as regras, incluindo sanções aos estabelecimentos que comercializam os produtos.

articles.title: Cine Ceará começa neste sábado em Fortaleza; veja programação completa | G1
articles.standfirst: A cerimônia de abertura vai homenagear Emilie Lesclaux e Kleber Mendonça Filho pela contribuição ao audiovisual brasileiro.
articles.summary: A cerimônia de abertura vai homenagear Emilie Lesclaux e Kleber Mendonça Filho pela contribuição ao audiovisual brasileiro.
articles.body:
A 36º edição do Cine Ceará (Festival Ibero-Americano de Cinema) começa neste sábado (7), às 19h, no Cineteatro São Luiz. A cerimônia vai homenagear Emilie Lesclaux e Kleber Mendonça Filho pela contribuição ao audiovisual brasileiro, com destaque para o cinema.

A primeira exibição da noite será o curta “Sul do Teerã”, dirigido por Kleber, sobre o cineasta iraniano Jafar Panahi (“Foi Apenas Um Acidente”), que reflete sobre a sua carreira e a perseguição no seu país, o Irã.

Na sequência, abrindo a Mostra Competitiva Ibero-americana de Longa-metragem, será exibido “Terra Firme” (Alexandre Vale. Ficção. 92’. Brasil. 2026)), filme que gira em torno do vínculo silencioso entre o menino Juca e o pescador Zé Cangulo. Eles vivem em uma vila litorânea esquecida pelo tempo, até que veem surgir uma possibilidade de recomeço.

Nesta edição, o evento festeja “ Fortaleza , 300 anos de luz e cinema”. O público poderá conferir mais de 45 filmes, entre longas-metragens e curtas em mostras competitivas e não-competitivas, com exibições no Cineteatro São Luiz e no Cinema do Dragão. Além de filmes, há debates, homenagens, ações formativas e outras atividades, todas com acesso gratuito.

36ª edição do Cine Ceará começa neste sábado em Fortaleza. — Foto: Luiz Alves/Divulgação

No domingo (8), a programação começa às 10h, no Hotel Sonata de Iracema, com o debate sobre o longa “Terra Firme”, com a presença do diretor Alexandre Vale, do ator principal Lisandro Di Prospero e da equipe do filme.

Às 14h, começa a Mostra Olhar do Ceará no Cinema do Dragão. Serão exibidos os curta-metragem, “Vejo você de repente” (Aída da Costa. Documentário. 13’. Brasil. 2026), “Erô” (Antônio Fargoni. Documentário. 10’. Brasil. 2026), “Umbuzeiro” (Emílio Ribeiro. Ficção. 19’. Brasil. 2026), e o longa-metragem “Douvina” (Márcio Câmara. Documentário. 80’. Brasil. 2026). Após as sessões, haverá debate com os realizadores.

À noite, no Cineteatro São Luiz, a programação começa às 18h com os curtas “Joqueta” (Luciana Vieira. Ficção. 13’. Ceará. 2026) e “Amargô” (Giorgio Vinicius Casetta. Animação. 19’. Goiás. 2026), abrindo a Mostra Competitiva Brasileira de Curta-Metragem.

Na sequência, acontece a exibição de “Sob o mesmo sol” (Ulises Porra. Ficção. 103’. República Dominicana-Espanha. 2025), da Mostra Competitiva Ibero-americana de Longa-metragem.

Cinco personalidades e uma instituição serão homenageadas pelo 36ª Cine Ceará:

A produtora Emilie Lesclaux e o diretor Kleber Mendonça Filho na solenidade de abertura, no dia 7 - Emilie e Kleber são os nomes por trás de “O Agente Secreto”, que se tornou o filme brasileiro mais premiado da história, com 105 honrarias de toda a parte do mundo;

O jornalista, crítico de cinema e escritor Luiz Carlos Merten , no dia 9 - com quase 60 anos de carreira, cobre os principais festivais de cinema do mundo. Desde 1989, integra a equipe do jornal O Estado de S. Paulo;

A atriz Isis Valverde , no dia 10 – tem 20 anos de carreira e trabalhos de destaque na televisão, no cinema e no streaming;

A instituição Vila das Artes , no dia 11, em celebração aos 20 anos de atuação como equipamento cultural da Prefeitura de Fortaleza e pelo trabalho de difusão das múltiplas linguagens artísticas;

E a senadora eleita Luizianne Lins na cerimônia de encerramento da edição, no dia 13 - Jornalista e professora doutora em Comunicação, foi eleita senadora nas eleições de 2026, com mais de 2,8 milhões de votos, sendo a mulher mais votada da história do Ceará, tem uma forte ligação com cinema e o Cine Ceará, onde é assídua espectadora, além de já ter participado como realizadora.

Integrando a programação oficial do 36º Cine Ceará, de terça a quinta-feira, 10 a 12, acontece o Encontro Farol de Cinema, das 14h às 18h, no Hotel Sonata, em Fortaleza. O evento propõe um espaço de debate e formulação de diretrizes sobre os rumos da produção, difusão e gestão do mercado audiovisual no Brasil.

O acesso é gratuito, por ordem de chegada. Organizado pelo produtor e ativista Roger Pires e pelo diretor do Cine Ceará, Wolney Oliveira, o evento surge como uma oportunidade de alinhar a cadeia produtiva diante das transformações aceleradas do mercado.

O Encontro culminará na publicação de uma Carta-Manifesto. O documento apresentará proposições para o poder público e a iniciativa privada, convocando entidades e demais eventos do país a dar continuidade às pautas estratégicas construídas durante as atividades.

A Mostra Competitiva ibero-americana de Longa-metragem do festival reúne nesta edição seis filmes, dos quais, cinco de ficção e um documentário, que partem de histórias particulares para abordar questões relacionadas à memória, às relações humanas, à identidade e às transformações sociais. São produções do Brasil, do Peru e coproduções entre Equador, Chile e Alemanha e entre República Dominicana e Espanha.

A competição brasileira de curtas reúne 13 produções de diferentes estados (Bahia, Ceará, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Paraíba e São Paulo) e formatos, entre ficções, documentários e animações. O Ceará participa com quatro produções.

articles.title: Governo volta a decretar emergência em calçadão por conta de erosão | G1
articles.standfirst: Espaço, que já foi ponto turístico, apresenta graves danos estruturais há anos e está interditado para reparos. Medida inclui ainda cemitério em Rodrigues Alves que também apresentou problemas no solo.
articles.summary: Espaço, que já foi ponto turístico, apresenta danos estruturais há anos e está interditado para reparos. Medida inclui ainda cemitério em Rodrigues Alves por risco geológico.
articles.body:
O problema da erosão do calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho, no Centro de Rio Branco , levou a um novo decreto de emergência publicado pelo Governo do Acre nesta quinta-feira (5). A medida terá duração inicial de seis meses e prevê articulação de medidas de contenção e estabilização das áreas afetadas e definições sobre a realocação de comerciantes. (Veja imagens acima)

O decreto abrange também o município de Rodrigues Alves , no Vale do Juruá. Segundo a medida, o cemitério da cidade está entre áreas citadas em relatórios do Departamento de Estradas de Rodagem, Infraestrutura Hidroviária e Aeroportuária do Acre (Deracre) sobre áreas atingidas por fenômenos geológicos como movimento de massa.

Técnicos do estado e da gestão da capital fizeram uma vistoria conjunta no calçadão. A governadora Mailza Assis (PP) e o prefeito de Rio Branco, Alysson Bestene (PP), também concederam entrevista coletiva para falar das medidas para solucionar a degradação do local.

👉 No dia 12 de julho de 2024, cerca de 270 metros do Calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho foram interditados por conta dos riscos à população. À época, a Passarela Joaquim Macedo, também na mesma região, foi interditada pelo mesmo motivo. Os problemas na região que já foi um ponto turístico, são atribuídos às enchentes.

Vários trechos do calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho apresentam danos — Foto: Reprodução/Secom-AC

As autoridades anunciaram ainda, além do decreto, notificação formal da empresa contratada responsável pelas obras, a retirada temporária de feirantes da economia solidária e a elaboração de um plano de remanejamento para os permissionários afetados.

"Já está sendo feito um monitoramento diário sobre as condições da obra e, agora, chegamos à conclusão de que é necessária a publicação de um decreto para a retirada de parte dos comerciantes do trecho que oferece risco, evitando qualquer fatalidade”, afirmou Mailza.

"Para todo e qualquer tipo de risco, o caminho é a prevenção por meio de esforços mútuos para monitorar e resguardar as pessoas no trecho do calçadão e do Mercado Velho”, comentou o prefeito da capital.

Técnicos do estado e do município fizeram uma vistoria conjunta no calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho — Foto: Reprodução/Secom-AC

Reparos que não solucionam são investigados

Em julho deste ano, o Ministério Público do Acre (MP-AC) instaurou um inquérito civil para que a prefeitura da capital aponte o que ocasionou as rachaduras e outros danos estruturais identificados no local.

Por meio de nota, o Executivo municipal esclareceu que embora a administração do local, no que se refere à organização, funcionamento e acompanhamento das atividades do espaço, seja da Secretaria Municipal de Agropecuária (Seagro), a parte de infraestrutura é com o Governo do Acre.

"Dessa forma, documentos, informações técnicas, contratos, projetos, fiscalização, execução, garantias, reparos ou eventuais responsabilidades relacionadas à obra devem ser solicitados e prestados pelo órgão responsável pela referida intervenção", complementou.

Segundo o documento, o órgão requisitou à Prefeitura de Rio Branco, através das secretarias responsáveis, a cópia integral do processo licitatório da obra, do contrato administrativo, dos projetos básico e executivo, memorial descritivo, cronograma físico-financeiro, planilhas orçamentárias.

A investigação do MP busca identificar eventuais responsabilidades na execução e fiscalização da obra de revitalização do espaço.

Além disso, o Ministério Público também pediu as Anotações de Responsabilidade Técnica (ART/RRT), laudos de vistoria e dos documentos de recebimento definitivo da obra, e solicitou informações sobre a garantia contratual da reforma, eventual notificação à empresa responsável pelos serviços e um plano de ação com prazo definido para a execução dos reparos emergenciais.

Conforme a portaria, a empresa executora da obra também deve apresentar, em até dez dias úteis, uma justificativa técnica para as rachaduras e demais danos identificados.

Conforme o documento, caso os laudos técnicos apontem risco iminente à vida ou à integridade física de quem frequenta o lugar, o Ministério Público pode pedir judicialmente a interdição cautelar, total ou parcial, do Novo Mercado Velho.

Em maio, Calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho, em Rio Branco, apresentou novas rachaduras em pilares recém-construídos — Foto: Reprodução

No dia 10 de junho, devido às chuvas que atingiram Rio Branco , a erosão no Calçadão do Novo Mercado Velho avançou e, por isso, foi necessário fechar novamente a área. No final de maio, o local voltou a apresentar rachaduras mesmo passando por obras de recuperação. Imagens mostraram fissuras nos pilares recém-construídos e na calçada que cobre a região.

O investimento inicial da obra que começou em 2023 foi estimada em R$ 300 mil, provenientes de recursos próprios do estado, à época, a previsão era que a obra fosse concluída em dois meses, o que não ocorreu. Já a Passarela Joaquim Macedo esta interditada há quase 2 anos.

Naquele ano, cerca de 480 famílias que trabalham na feirinha de Economia Solidária, tiveram que ser realocados para outros espaços. Parte dos trabalhadores estão atualmente na Praça Thomas Edison, localizada ao lado da Biblioteca Pública da capital.

Já em 2024, o Departamento Nacional Estradas de Rodagem (Deracre), responsável pela intervenção da passarela, disse que iria instalar cortinas atirantadas, além de estacas-prancha metálicas e 18 estacas que foram cravadas em um pilar que estava danificado.

Ainda naquele ano, o governo do Acre decretou emergência por causa das erosões registradas no leito do Rio Acre, que afetavam tanto o calçadão quanto à passarela.

Em julho de 2024, o governo já havia decretado emergência por conta de erosões nos leitos dos rios. Naquela época, os documentos abrangeram o Rio Acre, em Rio Branco, e o Envira, em Feijó.

Em Rio Branco, a medida apontava para o rompimento de calçadas, movimentação do calçadão do Mercado Velho e 'potencial risco aos prédios históricos e construções vizinhas', ocasionados pelas sucessivas reduções no nível do rio.

O decreto frisou a situação como 'desastre natural geológico', e teve vigência de 180 dias.

articles.title: Lixo no Guamá: Entulho bloqueia ciclofaixa e rua em Belém | G1
articles.standfirst: Resíduos domésticos, pneus e entulhos se acumulam às margens do canal da Mundurucus. Moradores relatam mau cheiro, presença de insetos e dificuldades para circular pela via.
articles.summary: Lixo no Guamá: Resíduos e entulho na Rua dos Mundurucus prejudicam a circulação e atraem insetos, forçando moradores a improvisar barreiras em Belém.
articles.body:
O acúmulo de lixo e entulho ao longo do canal da Mundurucus, no bairro do Guamá, em Belém, tem prejudicado a rotina de moradores e de quem precisa passar pela região. Na rua dos Mundurucus, entre a Alameda Bom Jesus e a Passagem Boa Vontade, os resíduos ocupam toda a ciclofaixa e parte da pista, dificultando a circulação.

No trecho, sacolas de lixo doméstico se misturam a pneus, pedaços de madeira, plásticos e restos de construção. Além de comprometer a passagem de veículos e ciclistas, o descarte irregular provoca mau cheiro e favorece o aparecimento de insetos e roedores, segundo os moradores.

A dona de casa Matilde Gomes mora em frente ao ponto de descarte e precisou instalar plásticos e telas no portão para tentar evitar o mau cheiro e a entrada de insetos e roedores.

“Eles passam de bicicleta, de moto, e vão jogando lixo. Eu tive que cobrir tudo aqui em casa por causa da sujeira e da poeira”, relata Matilde.

O comerciante Paulo Pereira também enfrenta dificuldades para circular pelo trecho.

“É um problema sério. Precisava ter uma fiscalização mais constante e uma lei mais rígida para evitar que isso continue acontecendo”, afirma Paulo.

Segundo os moradores, a Prefeitura de Belém realiza a limpeza e a retirada dos entulhos, mas o lixo volta a se acumular pouco tempo depois.

A auxiliar de cozinha Carla Cordeiro também reclama da situação e relata que o descarte irregular continua mesmo após a passagem da coleta.

“As pessoas jogam lixo na maior cara de pau. Às vezes, a coleta nem passou ainda e já tem gente deixando lixo aqui na Mundurucus”, conta Carla.

articles.title: 'Why is this a special case?': Judge named accused in son’s fatal Mercedes crash gets anticipatory bail
articles.summary: KOCHI: The Kerala high court on Thursday granted anticipatory bail to an additional sessions judge whose minor son was allegedly involved in a car crash
articles.body: KOCHI: The Kerala high court on Thursday granted anticipatory bail to an additional sessions judge whose minor son was allegedly involved in a car crash that killed a scooterist on October 25.Justice Kauser Edappagath granted the relief after observing that there was nothing to suggest that the judicial officer would not cooperate with the ongoing investigation.The court questioned the need to arrest the judge, noting that his house had already been searched and items seized by investigators."You have searched his house seized everything. This is something affecting the liberty of a person, whether District Judge or anyone. You have no case that he has not cooperated," the court observed, as quoted by website Bar and Bench.It also questioned the state's insistence on custodial interrogation, even while considering the allegations against the judge to be true at this stage."Why is this a special case? A 16-page objection? This is an unfortunate case no doubt… Let's assume that all your allegations are true at this stage and the offence is prima facie attracted, including Section 105 BNS. Even then, why do you want to arrest him? Why do you want his custody?" Justice Edappagath asked the state's counsel, as quoted by Bar and Bench.The judge further questioned whether the judicial officer would refuse to cooperate with investigators."As a responsible officer of this court, do you think that a District Judge will not cooperate? The fact that you oppose the bail application shows that you want his arrest. Why is an arrest required? You mean to say that he will speak the truth only under custodial interrogation? It is very unfortunate to hear it from a lawyer," the court said, as quoted by Bar and Bench.What happened in the accident?The case relates to an accident in the early hours of October 25, when a 54-year-old man died after his two-wheeler was hit by a Mercedes-Benz car allegedly driven by the judge's minor son.The collision occurred near Cheranelloor between 2am and 3am, police said.A case was registered under Section 106 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which deals with causing death by negligence.The minor was subsequently released on bail in accordance with the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act, police said.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Kochi | Silver Rate in Kochi | Bank Holidays in Kochi | Public Holidays in KochiStay updated with the latest Kochi news. articles.title: 45-year-old woman changing bedsheet plunges 15 feet into hidden Scindia-era chamber as floor caves in at historic house in Madhya Pradesh’s Bhind
articles.summary: BHOPAL: A 45-year-old woman fell nearly 15 feet into an underground pit, taking her bed down with her, when the floor of a room collapsed at a historic
articles.body: BHOPAL: A 45-year-old woman fell nearly 15 feet into an underground pit, taking her bed down with her, when the floor of a room collapsed at a historic house in Bhind on Wednesday night.The house, once a Scindia-era administrative court, sits atop an old chamber that was used to store grain collected as tax. She was changing the bedsheet when the ground gave way, said sources.The incident occurred at approximately 9:15 pm at a residence in Girls School Wali Gali. Family members and neighbours rescued her by lowering a ladder into the pit. She was admitted to hospital with injuries, and her condition is reported to be stable.According to the family, the premises functioned as a local administrative court during the Scindia State period and was used for revenue collection and administrative work in the surrounding areas. Grain collected as tax was stored in an underground structure locally known as a “galla khanti.” The cavity that opened on Wednesday is believed to be part of this original structure.The family said their great-grandfather, Pandit Madan Mohan Mishra, served as an honorary magistrate under the Scindia State and was also entrusted with duties related to the Van Khandeshwar Mahadev temple, say locals.The house was reconstructed in the 80s, and the family says the pit was sealed at that time. They suspect that years of water seepage gradually washed away the soil inside the abandoned structure, leaving a hollow beneath the floor that eventually gave way under pressure. Water was found at the bottom of the pit.Most household members were attending an invitation when the accident occurred and returned to find the woman trapped inside. articles.summary: A year after Jeff Bezos’ ex-wife MacKenzie Scott gave $30 million to a Silicon Valley-based nonprofit community loan fund Housing Trust Silicon Valley has
articles.body: A year after Jeff Bezos’ ex-wife MacKenzie Scott gave $30 million to a Silicon Valley-based nonprofit community loan fund Housing Trust Silicon Valley has unveiled a 10-year strategy aimed at turning the one-time gift into lasting housing solutions across the Bay Area. The organisation says the funding will help expand affordable housing initiatives, support first-time homebuyers, strengthen policy advocacy efforts and back innovative housing projects over the next decade. a San Jose-based community loan fund, announced on September 30, 2025, a 10-year plan for turning the unrestricted gift from Scott’s Yield Giving fund into long-term housing solutions across the Bay Area.From MacKenzie Scott’s surprise donation to long-term strategyHousing Trust announced the donation on October 2, 2024. CEO Noni Ramos called it “the largest from an individual in our history” and said it came as a surprise. The gift was unrestricted, which means the nonprofit can decide how to use it, and it was meant to help the organisation expand its work across the 14-county greater Bay Area. At the time, early ideas for the money included seeding a new capital raise for its loan fund, expanding existing programmes and launching new initiatives to deepen partnerships and increase equity and affordability in housing.The release highlighted two recent projects as examples of its work. At Meridian Apartments in Sunnyvale, Housing Trust provided a $2 million predevelopment loan, in partnership with Related California, to help create 90 affordable homes for families. In San Rafael, it supported Eden Housing with a $4 million loan for Vivalon, a 66-unit development for older adults that pairs affordable homes with supportive services.The 10-year planThe plan, developed with input from staff, the board and community stakeholders, has five major initiatives:* Lending capital and new products: Expanding the core revolving loan fund and piloting new tools to meet developers’ changing needs. More details were due at the organisation’s Investor Briefing on October 15.* Homeownership expansion: Beginning in 2026, extending first-time homebuyer programmes to reach more households across a wider area.* Policy and partnerships: Hiring new staff to strengthen advocacy and collaboration across sectors that could unlock more resources and affordable housing.* Impact measurement and management: Launching a framework in early 2026 to better track, evaluate and communicate results.* Innovation investments: Supporting mission-driven housing innovations that can reduce costs, shorten development timelines and increase affordability.Noni Ramos CEO of Housing Trust said the gift allows the organisation to take bold steps and carries both the responsibility and the freedom to scale what works, take calculated risks on new ideas and widen its reach. Board Chair Lisa Gutierrez, a senior vice president at U.S. Bank, said the plan is not about one-time dollars but about building momentum that compounds. By putting the funds to work strategically, she said, Housing Trust can attract new partners, expand homeownership and make loans to create and preserve rental housing in ways it could not before, while also strengthening the organisation itself.Building on 25 years of housing investmentThe announcement comes as Housing Trust Silicon Valley marks its 25th anniversary. Since its founding in 2000, the community development financial institution says it has invested more than $690 million, helped create over 28,700 affordable housing opportunities and supported more than 53,800 residents in finding homes they can afford. The organisation says its work has also leveraged nearly $9 billion in additional public and private capital.Board Chair Lisa Gutierrez said the goal is to use the donation strategically to attract new partners, expand homeownership opportunities and support loans for creating and preserving affordable rental housing, while strengthening the organisation's long-term capacity.The nonprofit said the decade-long strategy is designed to ensure that MacKenzie Scott's donation continues generating impact long after the original gift was received, helping create more affordable and stable housing opportunities across the Bay Area.You use AI every day. articles.title: In 2014, Rory McIlroy committed £1 million to help establish Daisy Lodge, a support centre for children with cancer; by its 10th anniversary, the centre had provided more than 4,000 breaks to families.
articles.summary: Rory McIlroy loves to win. The Northern Irish golfer has four major titles, and he has never pretended otherwise.
articles.body: Rory McIlroy loves to win. The Northern Irish golfer has four major titles, and he has never pretended otherwise. But his idea of winning goes beyond the golf course. For McIlroy, success also means making a difference in the lives of others. That’s exactly why he donated £1 million to help establish Daisy Lodge, a therapeutic short-break centre in Newcastle, County Down, for children with cancer and their families. The centre, which started as a place of support for families facing difficult times, has now grown into something much bigger. Ten years after opening, Daisy Lodge had provided more than 4,000 therapeutic short breaks, helping families spend time together away from the demands of hospital appointments and cancer treatment.Daisy LodgePeople go on holidays to picturesque places. But Daisy Lodge, set against the Mourne Mountains in Newcastle, County Down, was built for a different purpose. It was created for the hardest weeks a family can face. The therapeutic short-break centre has spent a decade giving families a quiet place to rest, talk and be together.The Cancer Fund for Children opened the lodge in 2014. What’s unique about the centre? It’s not a hospital. Families come here for a short break. The centre arranges meals and organises workshops, while therapies are also part of every stay. But nobody is taking a blood test in the lounge. In the ten years since its opening, the charity says more than 4,000 families have come for a short break. These include parents with a child undergoing treatment, parents who have just received a diagnosis and families grieving the loss of a child.Rory McIlroy commits £1 millionRory McIlroy committed £1 million from his foundation to support the work. In 2014, during the centre’s development, he said the model should be replicated. “I definitely think it is a project I would like to see replicated and I think can be replicated. I don't think there is any reason why we should stop here,” he said, as reported by ITV.McIlroy’s name, attached to the centre, brings the work to the attention of people who might never have come across it otherwise. And the golfer says he is touched to be part of the vision. "It is about giving back and being able to help others."What the support means for the familiesIn 2025, the centre supported 962 individual families and received 293 new family referrals, according to its year-end report. “521 families availed of a short break at Daisy Lodge Newcastle,” Peter O’Brien, the chairperson, said in a statement. Unfortunately, 83 people supported by the charity died from cancer last year. “We are continuing to offer bereavement support to their families as they come to terms with their grief.”For families, the value of this support is beyond words. "Having individual support during the last six months for my son has been priceless. He has been able to learn to start to open up more about his feelings to me as his mum and to not be afraid of showing them and communicating his needs,” one parent said.Another parent described how the short break brought so much joy to their child’s life. “It was good for my daughter to talk to someone outside the family and be able to speak about her worries and thoughts. It has helped her deal with her emotions and worries and what she feels inside. She is back to being the happy child we had before cancer made an appearance in our lives.”Over the decade, the lodge has celebrated 280 birthdays, held 7,950 therapeutic workshops and offered 8,925 complementary therapies, according to the charity. The kitchen team has also baked 82,000 pieces of Daisy Lodge shortbread! It may not seem exciting to everyone. But for a family in the middle of treatment, a baking class or a massage can be the first hour in weeks that feels ordinary.The charity is also planning a second lodge, Daisy Lodge Cong, in County Mayo, so it can support more families.You use AI every day. articles.title: Bhopal homemaker Anjita Sabhlok has turned old newspapers and plastic bottles into a way to buy food; her Kachra Cafe initiative says it sent more than 45 tonnes of household waste for recycling in eight months
articles.summary: Old newspapers, empty plastic bottles, cardboard boxes and discarded household items usually end up in a waste bin or are sold to a scrap dealer.
articles.body: Old newspapers, empty plastic bottles, cardboard boxes and discarded household items usually end up in a waste bin or are sold to a scrap dealer. But in Bhopal, these everyday items can help people get a meal, a cup of coffee or other essentials. Homemaker Anjita Sabhlok started Kachra Cafe, an initiative that allows residents to exchange recyclable household waste for food, drinks and everyday products.In just eight months, the initiative has sent more than 45 tonnes of waste for recycling. The idea is to make waste segregation more than an environmental responsibility by giving people a practical reason to do it.According to the official website of Kachra Cafe, Sabhlok launched it through her NGO, Mannat, in collaboration with the Bhopal Municipal Corporation. The initiative aims to encourage residents to separate recyclable waste at home instead of throwing everything away together.The question that led to Kachra CafeSabhlok had been working on environmental awareness and waste management through Mannat for several years. However, she felt that educating people about the importance of waste segregation was not translating into enough action. As she wondered, “We’re educating people, but are we really seeing a change?”This made her think of a different approach. Instead of repeatedly asking people to manage their waste responsibly, she wanted to give them an incentive to do so. That thought eventually became Kachra Cafe. The concept allows residents to bring recyclable materials collected from their homes and exchange them for food and everyday essentials. Each category of waste has a fixed value, making the process simple for customers.How does Kachra Cafe work?The process begins at home. Residents collect recyclable materials such as old newspapers, plastic packets, cardboard, books, clothes and electronic waste and bring them to a Kachra Cafe collection centre. The waste is weighed and its value is calculated according to the material and quantity. Customers receive credits, also known as Kachra Coins or Kachra Currency, which they can redeem for food, beverages and other products.According to the cafe's official website, different materials have different exchange rates. For instance, paper is valued at Rs 15 per kg, books and notebooks at Rs 14 per kg, milk packets at Rs 12 per kg and hard plastic jars at Rs 14 per kg. Soft plastic is valued at Rs 20 per kg, while electronic waste is listed at Rs 50 per kg.The website also lists rates for other materials, including Rs 90 per kg for beverage cans, Rs 120 for aluminium, Rs 30 for iron, Rs 400 for brass and Rs 600 for copper.The collected waste is channelled towards recycling rather than being mixed with regular household garbage. Customers can then use the credits they earn to access food and other products through the initiative's participating outlets.More than 45 tonnes of waste sent for recyclingGetting people to change their everyday waste-disposal habits was not easy initially. Household waste is often treated as something that needs to be thrown away, and convincing residents to collect and separate it requires consistent effort. However, as awareness about the exchange model spread, more people began bringing recyclable materials to the cafe.According to The Better India, Kachra Cafe has sent more than 45 tonnes of waste for recycling in eight months. The initiative has also encouraged residents to learn how to segregate different materials so that they can enter appropriate recycling channels.The cafe's approach gives people a direct benefit for participating in waste management. Instead of depending only on environmental awareness campaigns, it connects recycling with something residents can use in their everyday lives.An idea that could extend beyond BhopalFor Sabhlok, the initiative is not limited to running a cafe in one city. She wants other cities to explore similar models that make waste segregation easier and more rewarding for residents. The larger ambition is to encourage communities to recognise the value of recyclable materials and make responsible waste disposal part of their daily routines.Kachra Cafe's model brings together two everyday concerns: the need to manage household waste responsibly and the need to make food and essential products accessible through a practical exchange.You use AI every day. articles.title: 'Huge clue'? Experts unravel a mysterious, tragic nose-down jet crash
articles.summary: A key piece of debris and a mayday transmission are among important clues that are helping experts make sense of the tragedy.
articles.body:
A complex mission lies ahead for investigators trying to determine why a Learjet dove into the ground and exploded in South Florida, killing nine people, including two children.

How did the pilots lose control of the aircraft? Did the jet go into a "Mach tuck," its nose suddenly pitching downward in a trajectory nearly impossible to recover from? What role did icing play in the fatal fall from the sky?

Investigators will scrutinize the towering and turbulent storm the jet encountered, every aircraft piece recovered and every word the co-pilot spoke to air traffic controllers in the final minutes of her life, expert pilots told USA TODAY. Those experts said pilots of the mid-sized high-altitude Learjet may have faced little margin for error in difficult flying conditions, raising concerns about "Mach tuck," an infamous nose-down flying condition.

"Every single one of those pieces will be a clue in putting this whole picture together," said Hassan Shahidi, president and CEO of the Flight Safety Foundation .

The Nov. 1 crash killed the pilot, co-pilot and seven passengers bound for the Bahamas when the Learjet 60 plunged to the ground at more than 300 mph and exploded into a fireball.

Learjet crashes in Florida, killing nine. See how it happened

National Transportation Safety Board investigators are pleading with the public for recovery of any piece of the wreckage that's found. Sometimes, the linchpin in an investigation can be just one screw.

Most of the Learjet 60's left elevator – a movable control surface on the horizontal stabilizer – was recovered in three pieces within one to four miles of the crash site, the NTSB announced Nov. 3.

It was a "huge clue," said Robert Joslin, associate professor with Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University's College of Aviation.

The pieces show at least one important part of the aircraft separated before impact. But investigators don't know whether it separated before or after the loss of control of the aircraft, identified as N722BD.

High-flying aircraft can leave little margin for error

As co-pilot Nathalia Filguieras, 20, described what was happening inside the Learjet to air traffic controllers, she said they were experiencing "overspeed."

Investigators will try to decipher exactly what prompted the overspeed, a condition when an aircraft is moving faster than safe or faster than its certified maximum.

Joslin and the other professional pilots who talked with USA TODAY did not speculate about the specific circumstances. But they said Learjets in general are known for being challenging in certain situations.

Learjets are capable of flying in thin air, high above the altitudes inhabited by many other planes. In the high-speed, high-altitude environment the jets can fly in, they operate with narrower margins of error than other planes at lower altitudes, Joslin said.

A Federal Aviation Administration directive once noted a Learjet could have "marginal controllability" when reaching above maximum suggested speeds.

It's too soon to say what sequence of events led to the overspeed and crash of N722BD.

In the narrow operating margin of high-speed, high-altitude flight, an aircraft could fly too slow and wind up in a dangerous stall, Shahidi said. Or flying too fast can produce aerodynamic instability that puts pressure on the structure of the airplane.

"This is something investigators will be looking at very closely," he said.

One rare event that can occur is a "Mach tuck," when aerodynamic changes cause the nose to tuck down in a position that's difficult, if not impossible, to come out of.

Another term popping up in conversations about the crash is "coffin corner." That's the point at which there's little leeway for pilots to operate and it's a position pilots try to avoid, Joslin said. It's the point in altitude when the difference between the slow speed at which a stall can occur and the maximum recommended speed approaches zero.

Joslin trained in the military to get out of a spin, but once an aircraft experiences an event that puts the aircraft nose down into a diving position, it changes the dynamics so much that it would be "very difficult to come out of," he said.

Safety advances have reduced the number of such events that occur, pilots said.

The weather remains a major question, Shahidi said. Turbulence, either in clear air or storms, can narrow a Learjet's margin of error even further, by causing the aircraft to exceed its airspeed envelope.

The air ahead of this flight was anything but clear. The thunderstorm over Palm Beach County very rapidly reached a very high altitude, up to 40,000 feet, Shahidi said. Investigators will analyze what was happening with the turbulence inside that storm and whether it caused a loss of control in the aircraft.

Ice buildup reported on the aircraft also will be an important part of the investigation, because it could have contributed to the loss of control of the jet, Shahidi said.

A Learjet's thin wings are more prone to ice buildup than some other aircraft, Joslin said. "So all these things make it very challenging and once you get up in that thin air, you don't have the capability, because of its design, to maneuver without going outside the envelope."

Some previous nose-down crashes share similarities

Based on NTSB reports, two similar nose-down crashes occurred in 1980 and 1981, both after reportedly encountering clear air turbulence.

In May 1980, a Learjet 25D crashed into the Gulf , killing both people on board, after the pilot reported the aircraft was in a spin. The NTSB concluded the aircraft flying beyond its Mach limits contributed to the crash, describing the "Mach tuck" that can occur when the wing's center of pressure moves and results in a nose-down pitching moment.

A Learjet 24 crashed near Felt, Oklahoma on Oct. 1, 1981, killing two people on board. The NTSB attributed part of the crash to the aircraft's marginal controllability characteristics when flown beyond its Mach limits, resulting in a loss of control.

In an emergency 2003 airworthiness directive , the FAA said a Learjet Model 45 had experienced a severe vibration incident, followed by a sudden nose-down pitch. An investigation revealed a screw on the horizontal stabilizer actuator assembly had fractured and a threaded nut in a secondary retaining rod had worked off, resulting in the loss of control of the aircraft.

That structural failure could result in the loss of control of an aircraft, the FAA warned, advising immediate inspections.

An 'absolutely critical' piece of the investigation

NTSB investigations can sometimes be lengthy and it could be months before the world learns whether aerodynamics, the weather, a failed part or something else entirely played a role in the downward plunge of N722BD .

Every fatal crash is sad, but experienced pilots who have heard the air traffic control audio that went public describe it as one of the most harrowing they've ever heard.

"It's just awful. When you hear the voice of the co-pilot doing her job very well under these circumstances, it's just unbelievable," Shahidi said. "I can't imagine anyone being able to perform as she did, absolutely flawless."

But, he added, the information she provided will be "absolutely critical."

Dinah Voyles Pulver covers climate change, disasters, environment and other news for USA TODAY. Reach her at dpulver@usatoday.com

articles.title: At 35, John Disselkamp quit a Louisville, Kentucky bank to mop floors for $600 a month; his First Class Commercial Cleaning now earns about $10 million a year, with 300 staff
articles.summary: Discover how John Disselkamp left his stable bank job to create First Class Commercial Cleaning, transforming his life and earning $10 million annually with 330 staff across the U.S.
articles.body: In an era when bank jobs are synonymous with financial stability and career success, John Disselkamp chose a unique career path. Instead of pursuing an office job, he abandoned his banking career in pursuit of understanding the commercial cleaning business. This included going back to zero financially and getting into an entirely new line of work.According to a January 24, 2024, Entrepreneur report, Disselkamp gave up his banking job in Louisville at the age of 35. He started as a janitor, earning $600 per month. He later founded First Class Commercial Cleaning in January 2016. The company grew into a business generating about $10 million in annual revenue and employing 300 people. His business started with office cleaning but has expanded to commercial services involving large office buildings and other professional facilities.Leaving a banking career Disselkamp decided to move away from banking not because of a new business opportunity or an already secured financial background. After working for several years in the banking industry, he began to doubt whether he wanted to devote his life to sitting behind a desk. Gradually, his desire to build something of his own grew stronger, prompting him to become an entrepreneur. The business model that interested him in particular was the recurring revenue model through a commercial cleaning contract. The idea of starting a commercial cleaning business came to him from a former customer in the banking industry who had created his own profitable company in the field.This phase was challenging: after quitting his job, Disselkamp moved in with his mother because he had $20,000 in credit card debt and no retirement savings. Later, he got employed in a janitor’s position, making about $600 monthly. This work enabled him to discover what it means to maintain commercial facilities, from choosing cleaning products to dealing with different types of floors and fulfilling the expectations of customers. At first, he lacked practical experience and often consulted people who had done the job before him.A cold call helped to secure the first major contractDisselkamp formally established First Class Commercial Cleaning in January 2016. The venture’s early growth depended on winning back the confidence of commercial clients, who can be cautious about working with a new company. One of the first big chances came as a result of constant attempts to contact local property management firms. He found a contact person on the company’s website and began calling. The calls weren't answered at first, but he kept trying, and the property manager eventually agreed to take his call. The conversation led to a contract to clean an eight-floor building of about 200,000 square feet.Securing the contract was a major milestone for the company. This was an opportunity for the company to establish itself as a reliable cleaning association working with bigger firms. Then, the company started moving from individual cleaning jobs to recurrent contracts for office buildings and other professional places. Eventually, it expanded its services to include commercial floor cleaning, carpet cleaning, window cleaning, day porter services, and post-construction cleaning.Building a business around employees and customer relationshipsThe expansion of the firm has been directly linked to Disselkamp’s focus on relationships and employee engagement within the workplace. Instead of viewing the cleaning process as just another service delivered by completing tasks, he has made efforts towards creating an environment where employees are treated well. He has often reiterated that the success of the company will depend upon the people doing the task, ranging from cleaners to supervisors and management. As stated in the interview with Entrepreneur in January 2024, he stressed the need to know about employees' personal lives to foster an atmosphere of trust in the workforce. This is because a good relationship between employees and management will help provide more consistency in service delivery.The company's financial growth has earned it recognition in the Louisville business community. According to Louisville Business First, First Class Commercial Cleaning generated revenue of $4.89 million in 2022, $9.14 million in 2023, and $10.84 million in 2024. This growth of 121.96% between 2022 and 2024 placed the company seventh on the publication's 2025 Fast 50 list. The business has also expanded beyond its original Louisville market and now provides services in Lexington, Indianapolis, Nashville, and St. Louis. Its expansion reflects the progress made since founder John Disselkamp established the company in January 2016, building it from a small commercial cleaning operation into a business with more than 300 employees nationwide.You use AI every day. articles.summary: Thiruvananthapuram Corporation plans to restart the stalled ₹157.5cr Attukal-Kalady-Ambalathara sewerage project in Dec using 16th Finance Commission funds.
articles.body: T’puram: A fresh lifeline appears to be in sight for the stalled Rs.157.5-crore sewerage project covering Attukal, Kalady and Ambalathara, with the city corporation moving to tap 16th Finance Commission funds and aiming to resume work in the first week of Dec.The corporation council approved the proposal on Saturday, opening a fresh funding route for the project that had come to a halt amid financial constraints. The proposal will now be placed before the district planning committee on Monday as part of the approval process.Corporation secretary Muhammad Shafi said all pending bills related to the project would be paid, including Rs 6 lakh required for obtaining road-cutting permission from the public works department (PWD). He said funding issues that had affected the progress of the project were being addressed.He added that the existing contractor could resume the work once the funding process was completed, and there would be no need to call a fresh tender, potentially avoiding further delays.The project had faced a major setback after the Rs 66.63-crore National Housing Bank (NHB) loan secured for it lapsed. The loan, availed in Sept 2024, lapsed in Feb 2026 after the required work-status report was not communicated to the NHB. The corporation came to know about the lapse only in July, adding to the uncertainty over the project’s funding.The funding crunch subsequently affected payments and the pace of work. The contractor had already mobilised labour and machinery, and around 1km of sewer pipeline work had been completed before the project was stalled. The corporation is now moving to clear pending payments and address other requirements, including the Rs 6 lakh PWD payment, before restarting the work.The two packages are now estimated at Rs166.5 crore and Rs 22 crore.The proposed Dec restart is particularly significant for Attukal ahead of next year’s Attukal Pongala. articles.title: Sheinbaum congratulates Hinojosa, Becerra on historic wins
articles.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum on Wednesday congratulated Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa (D) on her historic victory as the Lone Star State’s first Latina governor and California Gov.-elect Xavier Becerra (D), who will become the state’s first Latino governor in more than a century. “I would like to highlight the achievement of two individuals of Mexican…
articles.body:
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum on Wednesday congratulated Texas Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa (D) on her historic victory as the Lone Star State’s first Latina governor and California Gov.-elect Xavier Becerra (D), who will become the state’s first Latino governor in more than a century.

“I would like to highlight the achievement of two individuals of Mexican origin: the governor-elect of California and the governor-elect of Texas,” Sheinbaum said at a press conference translated by Courthouse News .

Sheinbaum said their victories were a source of pride for Mexicans and that beyond their political platforms and Mexico’s historic ties to both Texas and California, they both hold strong ties to the Mexican community, United Press International reported.

The Mexican leader told reporters that the election results reflect “a sentiment among the American people,” according to the outlet.

Hinojosa won her race against incumbent Gov. Greg Abbott, depriving the Republican of a fourth term in office. She became Texas’s third woman to become the state’s chief executive, after former Gov. Ann Richards (D), who served from 1991 to 1995, and former Gov. Miriam A. Ferguson (D), who led between 1925 and 1927, and again between 1933 and 1935.

Abbott conceded and said his administration would work with Hinojosa’s team to transition into the governor’s mansion.

The win was part of a strong night for Democrats in Texas that did not apply solely to Hinojosa: Sen.-elect James Talarico (D) beat state Attorney General Ken Paxton (R) in the Senate race, Democratic state Rep. Vikki Goodwin defeated Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick (R), and Democrats won the races for state attorney general, comptroller, railroad commissioner and agriculture commissioner.

Becerra, former Health and Human Services secretary under former President Biden, defeated Republican Steve Hilton after running on his experience and appeal to Latinos, who make up a significant portion of the Golden State’s electorate. He will succeed term-limited Gov. Gavin Newsom (D), a potential contender in the 2028 Democratic presidential primary.

Becerra’s victory marks the first time a Latino has become California’s governor since Romualdo Pacheco, who served from February to December 1875.

Texas, once Mexican territory, won its independence in 1836 and was admitted into the union in 1845 under President James K. Polk, according to the State Department’s Office of the Historian . California joined the union following the Mexican-American War in 1850, two years after the start of the Gold Rush, the California State Parks noted.

articles.title: President of Paraguay faces criminal investigation and impeachment after bank collapse
articles.summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned from office this Thursday after Ueno Bank was shut down in the middle of the night due to a solvency crisis, leaving customers unable to access their money and triggering a scandal.
articles.body: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña is facing a criminal investigation and impeachment proceedings following the collapse of a major bank. Peña resigned from office earlier on Thursday after Ueno Bank was shut down in the middle of the night due to a solvency crisis, leaving millions of customers unable to access their money and triggering a scandal. Paraguay’s Attorney General has opened three criminal cases against Peña and other former officials related to the bank crisis. The lower chamber of Congress has approved his impeachment, accusing him of “serious and systematic dereliction of duty” in connection with his dealings with the bank. The Senate later announced that it would start an impeachment trial. Peña said he would present himself in the trial and defend himself: “I will do so with arguments and evidence, with respect for the Constitution and the institutions of the Republic,” he said. Peña submitted his resignation while lawmakers were debating charges brought against him by 35 opposition lawmakers and ruling-party dissidents. The charges proposed “removing from office” the president, who took power in August 2023 for a five-year term. Soon after he announced he would resign, Paraguay’s Chamber of Deputies voted unanimously to trigger impeachment proceedings. Both chambers of Congress then convened a joint session to consider his resignation, but it was adjourned without a decision after several lawmakers walked out in the middle of the vote. If lawmakers had accepted his resignation, he would have been given immunity and special protections; if they remove him from power, he won’t. Lawmakers that oppose the president said Peña is still president and must face justice. His impeachment trial started in the Senate on Thursday night and is expected to continue Friday. “This guy, Santiago Peña, needs to be jailed. An arrest warrant must be issued … pretrial detention, straight to jail,” Senator Yolanda Paredes told reporters earlier. Peña’s party, the right-wing Colorado Party, has a majority in both houses of Congress. The presidential office insisted that Peña would show up to the trial. A spokesperson dismissed rumors that he had fled the country, saying he remains in the capital without specifying his exact whereabouts. Peña said earlier that he was resigning to give peace of mind to Paraguayans “who entrusted their savings to our financial system.” “I have made the decision to submit my resignation from the Presidency of the Republic. I do so with the stability of our country, social peace, and the need to preserve our public institutions in mind,” he said in a message posted on social media. Peña entered office as one of the youngest presidents in Paraguayan history at the age of 44. He served as Minister of Finance from 2015 to 2017 during the presidency of Horacio Cartes and also served as a director of the Central Bank. He is one of the staunchest allies of US President Donald Trump’s administration and has aligned with Trump’s political priorities, particularly on immigration and security. How the scandal unfolded Paraguay’s president became embroiled in the crisis that erupted after the intervention of Ueno Bank, a private institution to which he has been linked and which, during his administration, received millions in funds from public entities, including the Social Security Institute (IPS), which manages the pensions of most of the country’s workers. CNN contacted the presidency before Peña’s resignation to ask about the allegations against him. The Central Bank of Paraguay found that Ueno Bank’s solvency ratio — with 2.9 million customers in a country of 6.1 million people — had fallen below 50% of the required minimum, “as a result of adjustments made to its financial statements during the regularization process.” As a result of the resolution or dissolution proceedings, the savings of millions of customers were frozen at the financial institution, which is also known for sponsoring local soccer teams and Paraguay’s national team. Attorney General Emiliano Rolón Fernández ordered the opening of three cases to investigate “the supervision and resolution of Ueno Bank SA, the placement of public funds in said entity and the actions of authorities from different State institutions.” Paraguay was shaken by Tuesday’s intervention of Ueno, an institution that, according to authorities, violated limits on loans to related companies. Paraguay’s Central Bank said Thursday night it would start processing guarantee payments to certain Ueno customers in stages. Peña announced his resignation after two days of long lines at banks, anxiety and street protests. The country has been trying to position itself as a regional financial hub by capitalizing on the investment-grade status it attained in recent years, after receiving approval from two of the world’s leading rating agencies. This is a developing story and will be updated.
